external_entities.name: developer
external_entities.description: A developer who pushes branches and can log in to the build runner to initiate rebuilds.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
external_entities.notes: The text does not state where developers are located or which trust zone controls them.

external_entities.name: public package registry
external_entities.description: The public package registry reached during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: build runner
processes.description: Picks up merges, fetches source, resolves dependencies, produces container images, pushes images, and calls the deploy controller.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.

processes.name: deploy controller
processes.description: Maintains the current image release for the estate and responds to store server queries.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.

processes.name: store server
processes.description: A small back-office server at each store that runs the till software container and checks for and retrieves new releases.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.

processes.name: till software
processes.description: The till software running as a container on each store server.
processes.source_excerpt: running the till software as a container

data_stores.name: git server
data_stores.description: The self-hosted Git server receiving developer branches and merges.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server, which sits on the corporate network.

data_stores.name: image registry
data_stores.description: The registry storing finished container images tagged with commit SHAs.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores.

data_stores.name: public package registry
data_stores.description: The public package registry from which dependency-resolution downloads are obtained.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: The developer pushes branches to the Git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: pick up merge
data_flows.description: The build runner picks up a merge to main to start a build.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A merge to `main` is what starts a build. The build runner picks the merge up

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: The build runner fetches source from the Git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: fetches the source

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: The build runner reaches out to the public package registry during dependency resolution.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.
data_flows.data_description: dependencies downloaded according to the lockfile

data_flows.name: push image
data_flows.description: The build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: finished container image tagged with the commit SHA

data_flows.name: make release
data_flows.description: The build runner asks the deploy controller to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When the image is pushed the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release.
data_flows.data_description: image SHA and current release designation

data_flows.name: ask current release
data_flows.description: Each store server asks the deploy controller which release is current.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: A store server pulls the current image from the image registry when its release differs.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it pulls that image from the registry and restarts the container
data_flows.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: log in
data_flows.description: A developer logs in to the build runner.
data_flows.source_excerpt: any developer can log in to the build runner

data_flows.name: kick off rebuild
data_flows.description: A developer manually initiates a rebuild of main on the build runner.
data_flows.source_excerpt: kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand
data_flows.notes: This path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.
